contract.description: Generate an already locally validated structured LAD plan from a recipe_id (e.g. motor_start_stop_seal_in, forward_reverse_interlock, fault_latch_acknowledge, valve_open_close_interlock, pump_duty_standby_basic). Pass the returned plan directly to tia_lad_generate_block_xml; a separate plan/XML validation call is unnecessary unless generation or import reports an error.

schema_version.description: TIA schema version V16-V21 (V19-V21 are served through V18-format documents via TIA's official cross-version import; V15 unsupported). Omitted defaults to the project's openness_version (plc-code.project.json), falling back to V18 only if unknown; a V18 document will not import into a V16/V17 portal, so V16/V17 must pass the portal version.

signals.description: Optional recipe overrides: signal names or recipe-supported literal strings. step_sequencer additionally accepts steps[] below; other omitted fields use recipe defaults. Check signal polarity and scan order against the task.

steps.description: step_sequencer only: ordered steps, numbered from 1. outputs are energized while active; transition contacts are ANDed; empty transition advances unconditionally. next defaults to the following step, last to 1.

contract.name: tia_lad_generate_recipe_plan
